purpose: Expose installed third-party visual tools through one explicit optional connector boundary without classifying any external executable as AXM-native capability.

properties.cwd: explicit working directory outside the protected live machine body; required for execute
properties.args: argument vector passed directly to the selected executable without a shell; required for execute
properties.allow_execute: must be boolean true for execute

contains: return code and captured-output SHA-256 receipts
separate tool-execution and visual-output observation claims

relationships: AXM native visual runtime remains a separate AXM-owned execution path and does not depend on this capability
Blender is represented here as an external optional tool even though legacy Blender-backed forge code also exists in the repository
the connector bus performs no downloads or installations
external execution is explicit and never uses a command shell
limitations: a connector being declared does not mean the corresponding software is installed
PATH discovery proves only that a candidate executable path was found; it does not make the software native to AXM
tool execution does not by itself prove that a visual result was rendered correctly
Unreal Engine and Houdini intentionally have no guessed default version probe; they can be inspected and explicitly executed when present
third-party licenses, updates and runtime behavior remain outside AXM authority

truth.basis: Every result names the external boundary, native=false, availability evidence, actual executable and observed process result without converting external capability into an AXM claim.

agency.basis: The caller chooses the tool and arguments; execution requires allow_execute=true and an explicit working directory.

continuity.basis: The AXM-owned native runtime remains independently routable; missing external tools do not remove the native capability.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Inspection and conservative probes are separate from execution, shell invocation is disabled, process time is bounded, and visual output is not inferred from exit status.
